migration: 1.0.0 to 1.1.0: anchors made game-agnostic (constants live in the game profile), lens gates added; ids, weights and passAt unchanged; 1.1.0 to 1.1.1: gameProfile generalized to your-game-profile for the public kit and hash recomputed with the documented kit algorithm (spec/RUBRIC_HASH.md); ids, weights, anchors and passAt unchanged; 1.1.1 to 1.1.2: Updated the public source note. Scoring rules and pack fields are unchanged. 1.1.2 to 1.1.3: Evidence descriptions and fixture working directories now refer to the distributed kit. 1.1.3 to 1.1.4: Empty samples and zero case counts earn U. Computed lines require the declared evidence type. Assist parity compares at least two device samples. Detection rates must agree with their labelled populations. 1.1.4 to 1.1.5: Adds individual authority and reward cases, labelled assist devices and separate client/server geometry, rotation and spawn evidence. 1.1.5 to 1.2.0: Line, pillar and anchor wording made genre-neutral (ids, weights, conditions and pass marks unchanged); adds owner-selected not-applicable profiles turn-based, no-input-assist. 1.2.0 to 1.3.0: Evidence pack names made genre-neutral (triggerParity to actionParity; wallObscuredSent to hiddenStateSent; relyOnRadiusOnly to relyOnDistanceOnly; interest to hiddenInfo; sybil to multiAccount). Scoring, weights, conditions and pass marks unchanged; rename these fields in packs made for 1.2.0.
levels: Levels 0 to 4, or U. U earns zero points and excludes the line weight from measured coverage. Record skipped execution as NOT_RUN.

verdict: PASS, CONDITIONAL or BLOCKED is reported separately from the grade and coverage. An unresolved P0 blocks.
source: Server decision logs and synthetic fixtures support the fairness review. Record the confidence and evidence for each finding.
samplePolicy: Each computed metric group needs a nonempty population. Use the listed sample arrays or positive integer case counts. For other groups supply a positive integer measuredCases from the capture. Empty inputs or zero measured cases earn U and zero points. A measured zero failures is valid.

turn-based.reason: The server judges turns, not real-time hits, so there is no lag compensation window. Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.

no-input-assist.reason: The game has no aim, steering or other input assist. Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.
